column15: the handles/ lock mechanisms need to be easy to use. I have been trapped in washrooms before usually in places of transportation (plane/trains) also the blue iconography sucks. I have poor eyesight and cannot see things that are far away. Blue is a colour that fades into the background so if the washroom sign is that colour I cannot see it unless it is a giant sign. maybe experiment with a more bolder colour. Also I like hands free things, the less touching gross stuff the better. Also I like when stalls have an emergency button. we only have that for accessible washrooms (wheelchair users) why can't we have one for all of them?
